title: Bring the player back with a quick win mission
strategy: Offer a small, clearly winnable task that can be completed in a single short session and ends with a visible reward.
when_to_use: Use when weekly sessions are low or session length is short and the player needs an easy re-entry point.

title: Send a low-friction return reminder
strategy: Use a gentle reminder that points to a single next action instead of a broad promotional message.
when_to_use: Use when a player has gone inactive or churn risk is rising and the goal is to reduce time to next session.

title: Offer optional difficulty relief
strategy: Add an assist mode, hint, or fallback path that preserves autonomy while reducing frustration.
when_to_use: Use when difficulty is high, fail streaks are likely, or churn risk is elevated during progression bottlenecks.

title: Make the next milestone visible
strategy: Expose progress to the next reward, unlock, or milestone so the player can see what comes next.
when_to_use: Use when progression is slow or players are hovering near a milestone and need a stronger sense of momentum.

title: Protect the player's streak
strategy: Use streak protection, grace periods, or pause mechanics so a missed day does not break the habit loop.
when_to_use: Use when the goal is habit formation and the player already has signs of returning regularly.

title: Surface social or cooperative hooks
strategy: Invite the player into a shared challenge, guild objective, or co-op moment that makes the game socially sticky.
when_to_use: Use when the player engages more deeply with multiplayer, team goals, or social systems.

title: Use non-monetary reward ladders
strategy: Reward return behavior with cosmetics, convenience, or progression boosts that do not require spending.
when_to_use: Use when the player is not spending much and engagement needs a value-forward reason to return.

title: Resurface the tutorial or help overlay
strategy: Give the player a short refresher on controls, core systems, or tactical tips right where friction appears.
when_to_use: Use when the player shows signs of confusion, short sessions, or repeated early exits.

title: Run a time-boxed event with clear goals
strategy: Launch a limited-time event that has a narrow goal, a visible timer, and a concrete reward path.
when_to_use: Use when the game needs a strong return reason and the player has historically responded to events.

title: Ask for a preference check-in
strategy: Ask one or two simple preference questions so future messages and rewards can fit the player's intent better.
when_to_use: Use when telemetry is sparse or noisy and the assistant needs more explicit player preference signals.
